committee_action.action: Under study by the Technical Working Group(TWG) on 2012-05-22
committee_action.meethigh:
The Technical Working Group (TWG) tasked to consolidate the provisions of House Bill Nos. 2182, 4199, and 4219 re Enhancement of the Basic Education Curriculum or K to 12, held its initial meeting on 22 May 2012 at 9:30 am, Conference Rooms 14&15, RVM Building, House of Representatives, Quezon City.

Those in attendance were Reps. Rosenda Ann Ocampo, Mel Senen S. Sarmiento, Mariano U. Piamonte, Jr., Pryde Henry Teves, Magtanggol T. Gunigundo I, Luzviminda Ilagan, Jane T. Castro, Antonio L. Tinio, Thelma Z. Almario  resource persons from the Commission on Higher Education (CHED), Technical Education and Skills Development Authority (TESDA), Department of Education (DepEd), Catholic Educational Association of the Philippines (COCOPEA), Philippine Association for State Universities and Colleges (PASUC), Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE), Philippine Regulation Commission (PRC) and the secretariat of both Committees.  

The TWG agreed on the following:

â€¢	Section 1 - Short Title,  was adopted as presented
â€¢	Section 2 - Declaration of Policy, was adopted with amendments.  DepEd will include in the provision the rationale on the need to change the education cycle  
â€¢	Section 3 â€“ Definition of Terms, was adopted with the following amendments:

-	Deletion of the word â€˜compulsoryâ€™ in the definition of secondary education  
-	revise the wordings of the definition of secondary education 
-	provide for the definitions of junior high school, senior high school, alternative learning systems, out-of-school youth, adult learners, and education for those with special needs

â€¢	The DepEd was instructed to submit these definitions to the CBEC secretariat on Friday, 25 May 2012
â€¢	Section 4 â€“ Enhanced Basic Education Program, was adopted with the amendments by CHED, to include in the provision the use of Mother Tongue as the medium of instruction for grades 1 to 3 
â€¢	Rep. Gunigundo was assigned to reword Section 4
â€¢	DepEd, CHED, TESDA, DOLE, PRC, PASUC and COCOPEA to submit to the Committee their comments on the proposed substitute bill
â€¢	Section 5 was adopted with the following amendments:

-	provision of basic standards to serve as guide for DepEd in laying the foundation for curriculum development	
-	creation of a Curriculum Advisory Council

Agreements Made:

â€¢	The body adopted Section 1 of the reference substitute bill.

â€¢	On Section 2, paragraph 3 of the substitute bill, the body agreed to delete references to â€œWashington Accordâ€� and â€œBologna Processâ€� and in lieu thereof, inserted the phrase â€œinternational agreements and standardsâ€�.

1)	The body preferred to delete the separate definitions in items â€œ(h) Junior High Schoolâ€� and â€œ(n) Senior High Schoolâ€� and agreed to just integrate the definitions of these terms in the term â€œSecondary Educationâ€�;
2)	The body adopted the definitions presented in the position paper of Rep. Gunigundo, namely;  Formal Education, Kindergarten Education, Elementary Education, and Secondary Education, with an amendment that in the definition of Secondary Education, the terms â€œjunior secondaryâ€� and â€œupper secondaryâ€� be replaced with â€œjunior high schoolâ€� and senior high schoolâ€�, respectively;

Learners of non-Filipino citizenship shall be required to pay the necessary fees as specified by the DepEd.â€�

Integration of General Education Curriculum Subjects. â€“ In addition to the general education curriculum (GEC) subjects that may hereafter be determined by the DepEd as part of the new curriculum, subjects mandated by existing laws and currently being offered in tertiary programs shall be incorporated in the secondary education curriculum

â€¢	Section 8, Hiring of Graduates of Science, Mathematics, Statistics and Engineering

Hiring of Higher Education Institution Faculty. â€“ Notwithstanding the provisions of Sections 26, 27 and 28 of Republic Act No. 7836, the faculty of higher education institutions (HEIs) shall be allowed to teach general education subjects in the secondary education: Provided, That the faculty must be a holder of a relevant Masters degree:  Provided, further, That the faculty must have satisfactorily served for at least five (5) years of full-time service as such faculty.â€�

1)	Section 10 was re-numbered as the new Section 11; 
2)	The body agreed to revise the second sentence, to wit: â€œNotwithstanding the provisions of Section 27 of Republic Act No. 9258, otherwise known as the Guidance and Counseling Act of 2004, career and employment guidance counsellors, who are not registered and licensed guidance counsellors, shall be allowed to conduct career advocacy activities to secondary level students.â€�

â€¢	Section 11, Expansion of E-GASTPE Beneficiaries
